authority: Interpretive decision by model after offline biome, elevation and k2..5 map inspection; not an algorithmic semantic verdict
conclusion: Two topologically bounded research reference units with strong west-low/east-high contrast; internal east landform gradients remain continuous. No unique three-way natural partition established.

candidate_comparison.k2: Broad lowland versus elevated terrain. Lowland includes the west island and east island westward peninsula, therefore attributes do not equal island identity.
candidate_comparison.k3: Adds mostly an intermediate coastal/slope fringe, not a third compact island or uniquely bounded regional unit.
candidate_comparison.k4: Further separates mountain interior and intermediate slopes; boundaries follow continuous height/relief changes.
candidate_comparison.k5: Further divides higher cores and surrounding slopes. Additional classes explain gradation rather than establishing five discrete regions.

satellites: All 6945 satellite dry columns remain in full-scope statistics, topology, terrain and numerical candidates; they are not silently assigned a major-island identity or omitted from queries.
